actual_Boolean_family: Six-bit core with M negative points: (M+d)/2 lex-first points in coordinate-zero half and (M-d)/2 lex-first points in coordinate-one half. Compose six disjoint copies into h.
parameter_domain: M=1..63, d=0..min(M,64-M), d congruent M modulo2; |singleton|=d/32. Exact core truth tables supplied, not abstract spectral vectors.
symmetry: Sign of singleton may be quotiented for reserve only (squares); output complements kept since bias changes. No quotient of other spectra.
completeness: All achievable (p,beta_i^2) signatures for any six-bit Boolean table and any chosen coordinate; exactly complete for this signed reserve since it depends only on these two scalars. Does not enumerate all E minima or arbitrary higher-dimensional cores.
arithmetic: Integer negative half counts, exact Fractions, rigorous96-bit logarithm intervals from search.py; symbolic beta=0 equality
why_this_family: Tests the smallest sign-aware repair after the bias-blind reserve failed: orient g so P(g=-1)<=1/2 without changing its E,H,I. Projection completeness avoids an n=6 truth-table census.
